title: Supreme Martial Arts

services.name: Kids Taekwondo
services.desc: My daughter has been going to Supreme Martial Arts for about 7 months and she really enjoys the classes and the culture of the organization. The teachers are very good and the classes are very active. I have seen her confidence grow from being a part of the classes and she looks forward to learning new things every week. Thanks very much ! My son has been going there 2 years since he was 4. Although I feel they could give a little more individual explanation how to correct what the kids are not doing right, overall, the teachers comes with good credential, truly love and enjoy the kids, give a good balance of discipline and caring. During the bell test, the school Master gives life lessons
